title: HIDIVE Confirms 2027 Release for Major Isekai Movie Return After 4 Years – Watch New Trailer
content:
There’s a major Isekai anime franchise coming back with a new movie next year after four years of waiting, and HIDIVE has now confirmed it will be overseeing its release outside of Japan with a new trailer and poster to help show it off. The anime adaptation for Daisuke Aizawa and Tozai’s The Eminence in Shadow light novel has become one of the quickest Isekai successes of the last few years , but it’s finally coming back for more with a new feature film picking up from where the TV series left off.

The Eminence in Shadow: Lost Echoes is a brand new feature film picking up from the events of the anime’s second season , and HIDIVE has now confirmed that they will be overseeing the release of the new movie for fans in North America and other territories. To help celebrate the new release, HIDIVE has dropped the first full trailer and poster for the upcoming movie to give fans the best look at what to expect yet. You can check it out in action below.

The Eminence in Shadow: Lost Echoes Confirms 2027 HIDIVE Release

The Eminence in Shadow: Lost Echoes will be making its debut sometime next year with HIDIVE overseeing its launch , but a concrete release window or date has yet to be confirmed as of this time. The film currently has a release slated for sometime in May 2027 in Japan, but hopefully the international release won’t be too much further out from that. You’re going to want to catch up with everything seen in the TV anime’s first two seasons with HIDIVE in the meantime as it’s throwing fans right back into the thick of the action with Shadow.

The Eminence in Shadow: Lost Echoes f eatures a returning production staff from the TV series with Kazuya Nakaishi directing the film for studio Nexus. Makoto Iino will be prodicing the character designs, Kanichi Katou will be providing the screenplay, and Kenichiro Suehiro composes the music. It’s set to feature some returning members to the voice cast such as Seiichiro Yamashita as Cid Kagenou, Yui Horie as Akane Nishino, Inori Minase as Beta, and Takehito Koyasu as Mordred. But there’s some new additions too.

What to Know for New Eminence in Shadow Movie

The Eminence in Shadow: Lost Echoes picks right up after the end of the second season from 2023 as Shadow found himself suddenly sucked into a portal to another world. It’s revealed to be a version of Japan that’s fell to ruin in unexpected ways, and the movie will see him reuniting with a familiar (but different) face for the experience. It seems like it’s a story that’s going to fit perfectly within all of the other events that The Eminence in Shadow is building to with the TV series, so fans will need to check it out to get the next step of the journey.

New additions to the voice cast for this new movie are Yukari Tamura as Yuka Asakura and Rie Kugimiya as Minoru, both characters who have yet to reveal their parts in what’s next. But it’s something to keep an eye on as Shadow’s story develops further. How are you liking the look of The Eminence in Shadow ‘s new movie return so far? Let us know all of your thoughts about it in the comments.

title: 'Free Fire Daybreak' Unveils Main Cast, Fourth Promo
content:
The Free Fire World Series Global Finals 2026 event revealed the main cast and a fourth promotional video for the television anime Free Fire Daybreak on Saturday. The anime series will premiere in April 2027.

Voice actors Kana Ichinose ( Sousou no Frieren ) and Seiichirou Yamashita ( Kage no Jitsuryokusha ni Naritakute! ) are starring as Kelly and Hayato, respectively.

Ken Takahashi is directing the anime at Studio CANDY BOX , with Hotaru Asafuji ( Azur Lane: Bisoku Zenshin! Ni!! ) handling the series composition and script. Kouji Fujimoto (Sus4 Inc.) ( Yozakura-san Chi no Daisakusen ) is composing the music.

Garena Free Fire is an immersive battle royale game developed by 111dots Studio and published by Garena in 2017, created for mobile devices. It was the most downloaded mobile game in the world in 2019, 2021, 2023, and 2024. The game has over 1 billion cumulative downloads on the Google Play Store, with over 100 million daily active users in February 2024. In September 2021, Garena released an enhanced version of the game titled Free Fire Max .

PV 4

title: Natsune Inui Joins Cast of #I'm Looking For a Zombie Anime
content:
Kadokawa revealed a new cast member on Sunday for the television anime of Katsuwo 's #I’m Looking For a Zombie ( #Zombie Sagashitemasu ) manga. Natsune Inui joins the cast as Zomko, a zombie the main characters meet on their journey who does not attack people and who is bad at communicating.

The anime debuted on October 3 in the IMAnimation programming block of TV Asahi and 23 of its affiliated channels, and airs on Saturdays at 11:30 p.m. JST. Crunchyroll is streaming the anime as it airs and is also streaming a same-day English dub.

The anime stars:

• Miyari Nemoto as Aki

• Lynn as Natsuki

• Toshiya Miyata as Haru

• Hibiku Yamamura as Yū

• Yuka Nukui as Sakura

• Yōko Hikasa as Mikazuki

• Makoto Koichi as Tōka

• Tomoyo Takayanagi as Takamo

• Aino Shimada as Saigo

• Kōsuke Toriumi as Aki's father

Shin'ya Une ( Rent-A-Girlfriend season 3 director, Teasing Master Takagi-san , D.Gray-man Hallow episode director) is directing the anime at Studio Comet , and Kyōhei Suzuki ( JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: Golden Wind , Kiss Him, Not Me assistant episode director) is the assistant director. Kenichi Yamashita ( Actually, I Am… , The Holy Grail of Eris ) and Aki Itami ( Forest of Piano , The Comic Artist and His Assistants ) are in charge of the series scripts, and Narumi Shimoji ( Charanpo Land no Bōken film, Ugoku! Neko Mukashi Banashi ) is designing the characters. Kenta Higashiohji ( Pole Princess!! , Reborn to Master the Blade: From Hero-King to Extraordinary Squire ) is composing the music.

Additional staff members include:

• Art Director: Masatoshi Muto

• Color Design: Ryōta Katsuta, Maki Yamamoto

• Compositing Director of Photography: Shintarō Sakai

• 3DCG Director: Junya Sato

• Editing: Yumiko Nakaba

• Sound Director: Yayoi Tateishi

Surii performs the opening theme song "Raki Raki," and the band cadode performs the ending theme song "Soft Apocalypse."

The "zombie x youth comedy" manga is set in a world where 90 percent of humans on Earth have contracted and died from a deadly, virulent disease; only to then rise again as zombies who attack people. 13 years after that "Red Day" of societal and civilizational collapse, the surviving humans live away from the big cities, while still hoping to retake them someday. An entirely new generation of people who know nothing of the pre-Red Day world are now coming into their own. The story begins when Aki and her close friends Haru and Natsuki begin a journey to find Aki's missing father.

Katsuwo launched the manga in Kadokawa 's Comic Dengeki DaiohG magazine in June 2022. Kadokawa published the third and final volume in January 2024.

Yen Press announced in July it will release the manga in a complete omnibus format under the title #ImLookingForZombies .

title: Texas' Anime Frontier to Screen World Premiere of Maiden Blood Anime
content:
The premiere will screen in Room 202CD. Anime Frontier will run from December 4 to December 6 in Fort Worth, Texas.

Maiden Blood will debut in 2027.

The dark fantasy action anime will star Iori Saeki as Eva and Yukari Anzai as Epica.

Pony Canyon describes the series:

Armageddon—the final war between good and evil, fought at the end of the world. Its destined outcome was overturned. “I don't want to die.” That desperate wish, that hopeless human ego, gave power to the Evil God. Eight billion human beings were offered as sacrifices, and only a handful were allowed to survive, doomed to be toyed with and tormented as playthings of the Evil God. Since the dawn of the universe, the Frashokereti—the Renewal of the World—has been repeated countless times. But here, for the first time, it has failed. The sun will rise no more. In a world where the very laws of nature have gone mad, there is only one thing of value: human blood. Blood is currency. Blood is fuel. Blood is—a weapon. After countless sacrifices, the mages devised a single ritual: a forbidden art that transforms a girl's blood into a blade capable of destroying demons. Turn blood into a weapon. Turn life into a weapon. Turn humanity itself into the final weapon against the demons. The chosen… the survivors… the strongest, cursed blood warriors. Blood warriors. The younger sister, Epica, is the strongest blood warrior, her soul stolen away. The elder sister, Eva, has been unable to walk since birth. And yet, in this entire world, only one thing can awaken Epica's sleeping power: Eva's blood. Eva and Epica. Sisters bound by fate in the darkness of the end of the world. To the demons who have defiled this world—with that blood… f×cking kill them all!

Kishi ( Persona 4 , Danganronpa , Assassination Classroom , Angel Beats! ), scriptwriter Makoto Uezu ( Scum's Wish , Kengan Ashura , KONOSUBA , Yuki Yuna Is a Hero ), and Pony Canyon are credited with the original work. Keiji is directing the anime at Polygon Pictures , and Uezu is overseeing the series scripts. LAM ( Witch and Hound , takt op. Destiny , Technoroid Overmind ) is the original character designer. Composers include: Keiichi Okabe ( Yuki Yuna Is a Hero , NieR:Automata Ver 1.1a ), Kuniyuki Takahashi ( Tune In to the Midnight Heart , Death March to The Parallel World Rhapsody ), and Taichi Jōraku ( insert song for The Dark History of the Reincarnated Villainess OAV ).

Other staff members include Satoki Iida as sound director. Pony Canyon is producing the music, and MONACA is credited with music production cooperation.

title: Naver Webtoon's Cuts Make App Wins Google Play's Best App of the Year Award for 2026 in S. Korea
content:
Naver WEBTOON announced on November 18 its short-form video creation app Cuts Make, which allows users to create derivative content based on webtoon intellectual properties (IP), has been named Best App of the Year in Google Play 's Best of 2026 awards in South Korea.

Google Play 's annual "Best of" awards recognize apps and games that have received significant recognition from users throughout the year.

Launched in June, Cuts Make allows users to create short-form animated videos, including character memes and webtoon music videos, using officially licensed webtoon IP. Users can select scenes and characters from their favorite webtoons, create short videos, and immediately upload their finished works to Naver WEBTOON 's short-animation user-generated content (UGC) platform , Cuts.

The app currently offers content from 20 webtoon titles, including Omniscient Reader’s Viewpoint , Love Revolution , Garbage Time , and Ctrl+Alt+Resign . Since its launch, the number of new creators uploading content to Cuts has increased by 24%, while the number of episodes uploaded has grown by 34%.

On November 2, Cuts Make introduced a new Story feature to expand its creative tools. The feature allows users to connect multiple scenes and incorporate text-to-speech, voice dubbing, and music to produce episodic content with more developed narratives.

title: Temppal: Overgeared PC, Mobile Game Debuts in Korea, Taiwan, Hong Kong, Macau
content:
Korean game developer and publisher NEXON released TEMPPAL : OVERGEARED , a new full-3D MMORPG based on the popular Korean fantasy web novel and webtoon Overgeared , in Korea, Taiwan, Hong Kong, and Macau on November 26.

Developed by GRAYGAMES and published by NEXON Korea, the game is available on PC and mobile. It features a third-person perspective and a seamless open world set in a medieval fantasy environment.

The original Overgeared web novel and webtoon have accumulated more than 1.3 billion combined views on Kakao Page in South Korea. In Japan, the series has surpassed 85 million Likes on the digital comics platform Piccoma and received the Piccoma Award in 2023.

Yen Press publishes the webtoon in English under its Ize Press label. Yen Press describes the story:

Youngwoo Shin is a deadbeat in real life, working odd jobs to barely pay off his loans. Even his family has written him off as a hopeless video game addict. But when he logs in to the massively popular VR game Satisfy, Youngwoo becomes Grid the Warrior... who is also painfully mediocre. Everything changes when he stumbles across a tome containing the lost knowledge of a legendary blacksmith. The catch is, using it resets all his levels! In order to survive after being forced back to square one, Grid will need to hone his skills and gather reliable allies... or not! Who needs all that when you're decked out in god-tier items?!

The webtoon is based on a web novel by Sae Nal Park . Dong Wook Lee is writing the webtoon, and Team Argo is drawing the art.

WuxiaWorld is releasing the original web novel series in English.

The webtoon inspired an ongoing television anime adaptation titled Tempal: Item no Chikara (Tempal ~The Power of Items~) that debuted on October 2. Crunchyroll is streaming the anime and is also streaming a same-day English dub.
author: ANN

title: Medaka Kuroiwa Is Impervious to My Charms Season 2 Unveils New Visual, Trailer, Theme Song Artists
content:
Medaka Kuroiwa Is Impervious to My Charms Season 2 unveiled a new visual and trailer along with the theme song artists on Saturday. performs The opening theme song “Mechachu!!” will be sung by HIMEHINA while the ending theme song “Hatsukoi no Distortion” is performed by Straight Angeli. Studio SynergySP will return to animate the sequel with Yoshiaki Okumura also returning as director. The new visual features the main cast:

Yoriko Tomita is the new scripwriter, replacing Kazuyuki Fudeyasu while Mayumi Watanabe returns as the character designer. The voice cast will also reprise their roles:

• Ryota Iwasaki as Medaka Kuroiwa

• Yu Serizawa as Mona Kawai

• Sora Amamiya as Asahi Shonan

• Kana Hanazawa as Tsubomi Haruno

• Hinaki Yano as Tomo Namba

• Kaori Maeda as Minami Shirahama

Medaka Kuroiwa Is Impervious to My Charms anime is based on a manga written and illustrated by Ran Kuze. It was originally launched as a one-shot in Kodansha’s Weekly Shonen Magazine in December 2020, and later began serialization in the same magazine in May 2021. Kodansha USA is publishing the manga in English. Crunchyroll is streaming the first season, describing it as: For Mona Kawai, winning hearts and turning heads comes naturally. Everything changes when Medaka Kuroiwa, a new transfer student, arrives. He won’t even give Mona a second look, and it turns her life upside down! Mona tries everything she can to win Medaka over, even going to the extreme at times. Tune in to a new rom-com about a queen bee and an unfazed boy among the school’s halls.

title: Noa Is My Senior and My Friend Anime Unveils Teaser Trailer
content:
Noa Is My Senior and My Friend anime unveiled a teaser trailer on Saturday. The anime is set to premiere in 2027 with studio feel. animating the series. The anime stars Rina Kawaguchi as Noa Saotome and Tomoya Ito as Rihito Otsuka. A visual was released last month.

Shinsuke Yanagi is directing the anime with Keiichiro Ochi is writing the series scripts. Yumiko Yamamoto is the character designer. Enma Akiyama writes and illustrates the manga the anime is adapted from. Weekly Young Jump has been serializing the series since 2023 and has 11 volumes in circulation. It currently has 12 volumes in circulation.

The series follows Rihito Otsuka, who works at a game company under Noa Saotome, an art director admired by her colleagues for her strong work ethic. However, Otsuka soon discovers a side of his senior that she keeps hidden from everyone else. However, Otsuka soon discovers a side of his senior that she keeps hidden from everyone else. title: Singer LiSA and Voice Actor Tatsuhisa Suzuki Announce Divorce
content:
Singer LiSA and voice actor Tatsuhisa Suzuki announced on Saturday that they have divorced after nearly seven years of marriage. The announcements were made through separate statements on their respective official websites.

In her statement , LiSA wrote, "After repeated discussions based on mutual respect and consideration, this is the conclusion we reached together." She also expressed her gratitude to Suzuki, saying, "I am sincerely grateful for all the efforts he has made for our family." Regarding their child, she added, "We will continue to work together to raise our child as parents." She concluded by reaffirming her commitment to her music career while cherishing her individuality as LiSA.

Suzuki also announced the divorce in a statement on his official website, writing, "We have decided to end our marriage and pursue our respective lives." He further stated that he would continue his activities as a voice actor and creator, as well as fulfill his responsibilities as a father.

LiSA and Suzuki announced their marriage in January 2020. LiSA later shared the news of the birth of their first child in April 2023.

LiSA has been widely acclaimed for her contributions to anime music, with theme songs for Angel Beats! , Fate/Zero , Sword Art Online , Mahouka Koukou no Rettousei , and Kimetsu no Yaiba . She gained recognition in 2010 as the vocalist for Yui of the fictional band Girls Dead Monster in Angel Beats! before making her solo debut in April 2011 with the mini-album Letters to U.

LiSA has received numerous awards for their music, including the Best Theme Song award at the 2017 Newtype Anime Awards for "Catch the Moment" and the 2019 Newtype Anime Awards for "Gurenge." She also received the Best 5 Songs by Download award at the 35th Japan Gold Disc Awards in 2020. In December 2020, she received the Grand Prix at the 62nd Japan Record Awards for "Homura," the theme songs for Kimetsu no Yaiba: Mugen Ressha-hen . Her song "Gurenge" also received the JASRAC Gold Award in 2021 and 2022 .

Suzuki is best known for his role as Ban in Nanatsu no Taizai , Makoto Tachibana in Free! , Ken Ryuuguuji in Tokyo Revengers , Haru Yoshida in Tonari no Kaibutsu-kun , Hiroomi Nase in Kyoukai no Kanata , and Ouma Tokita in Kengan Ashura .

Suzuki was also active as a singer in the rock band OLDCODEX , serving as its vocalist under the stage name Ta_2. The band performed theme songs for several anime, including Free! , Kuroko no Basket , God Eater and Servamp . In December 2021, OLDCODEX announced that it would end its activities in April 2022, coinciding with the release of the second Free!: The Final Stroke anime movie and its theme song.

Suzuki has received several awards for his work, including the Grand Prix in the Voice Actor category at the 37th Anime Grand Prix in 2014. He also received the Male Character Voice Award at the Famitsu Awards 2016 for his portrayal of Noctis Lucis Caelum in Final Fantasy XV .

title: Korea's EBS TV Network to Premiere 5 Generative AI-Assisted Animated Series in December
content:
South Korea's public educational broadcaster Educational Broadcasting System (EBS) will premiere five animated series created using generative artificial intelligence (AI) technology, beginning December 1. The series were selected through the broadcaster's 2026 Generative AI Animation Series Co-Production Project.

The five projects were selected from 429 submissions, representing about 86 entries per selected project. The productions combine generative AI with traditional animation techniques, including stop-motion, 2D, 3D, clay animation, felt puppetry, and paper cutouts.

To showcase the selected works, EBS will establish a dedicated AI animation programming block on EBS 1TV, airing Tuesdays through Thursdays from 5:20 p.m. to 5:50 p.m. KST.

The first series, Coconini's Fairy Tale Adventure Team , will premiere on December 1 at 5:20 p.m. The musical fantasy follows a cheerful child named Coco and Nini, a magical stuffed toy, as they travel into fairy tale worlds, overcome challenges with their friends, and tell their stories through songs and dances.

Stories Told by the Night will follow at 5:35 p.m. The series follows Hyeon, a lonely child who feels overlooked by his busy parents, as he explores different story worlds with a small AI device named Bam and learns about emotions and relationships. Each episode explores themes such as understanding, patience, courage, and waiting, while incorporating different visual styles, including felt puppets, colored-pencil drawings, clay animation, and traditional Korean folk painting.

On December 2, Euphoria Quest will premiere at 5:20 p.m. The comedic fantasy follows four novice adventurers who become separated after a mysterious explosion in a dungeon. As they confront their troubled pasts and reunite, they work together to uncover the dungeon's secrets.

At 5:30 p.m., Monobooks Cat Bookstore will debut. The series follows Mono, a quiet cat who runs a bookstore and comforts animal customers through the books he recommends.

The fifth selected series, Yellow Socks Popo , is scheduled to premiere in March 2027. Set in a facility where discarded single socks end up, the story follows a protagonist who challenges an army of plain white socks and discovers the importance of individuality and uniqueness.

EBS also plans to rebroadcast Euphoria Quest every Thursday at 5:40 p.m.

According to EBS, the project aims to support emerging creators and explore how generative AI can complement traditional artistic techniques. Rather than relying solely on AI-generated visuals, the selected productions combine the technology with handmade aesthetics and creative storytelling.
